name: Burnt building
description: A house after a fire: blackened walls, charred beams fallen inside, a collapsed roof and ash on the floor. Concept for review (#149): map decoration, random starting ruins, or what demolition (#130) or a battle leaves behind. No game mechanics yet.

variants.name: Burnt stone house
variants.notes: Soot-blackened stone walls, part of the roof still hanging.

variants.name: Collapsed after fire
variants.notes: Hardly anything stands: beams and ash.
